capabilities: PCMCI, PCMCI+, LPCMCI, regime and multi-dataset variants
limitation: Stationarity, graph semantics, CI-test assumptions and copyleft require explicit review
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.role: Temporal graph equivalence and graph-based effects
scientific_qualification.input: Time series, declared lag window, masks, background knowledge, discovery method and conditional-independence test.
scientific_qualification.output: Method-specific directed/undirected lag graph, time-series CPDAG or PAG; effects additionally require an assumed graph.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Method-specific stationarity and hidden-variable conditions; CI-test family matches distribution and dependence; an observed mask does not itself justify missingness.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Retain every endpoint, lag, test, window and method. PCMCI+, LPCMCI and regime variants are different model classes. A p-value matrix is not an effect estimate.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Use an autocorrelated confounded VAR and an observationally equivalent orientation example; assess graph-class coverage and admissible effect sets separately from edge F1.

evidence.finding: Explicit method assumptions/output classes, CI-test assumptions and declared features.
